basics.name: Devi Adi Nufriana
basics.label: Software Engineer
basics.summary: Frontend and full-stack engineer based in Jakarta. Over 7 years building and modernizing production web applications with Vue, React, and Go at Blibli, BRI Life, and Frisidea.

work.name: BRI Life
work.summary: Building backend integrations and internal tools for BRI Life's digital ecosystem, connecting core insurance workflows with third-party communication services.
highlights: Built a Go notification microservice handling WhatsApp, SMS, email, and push delivery across core systems.
Streamlined cross-team integration workflows, cutting redundant manual steps across internal operations.
Set up automated GitLab CI/CD pipelines to standardize builds and speed up deployments.

work.name: Blibli
work.summary: Led frontend modernization for customer-facing review and product pages, migrating legacy Java views to Vue.js and introducing automated end-to-end testing.
highlights: Migrated the Review Center from legacy Java templates to Vue.js, improving maintainability and user experience.
Rebuilt the Review, Hall of Fame, and feed pages with modular Vue components.
Added end-to-end Playwright test suites to catch regressions before production release.
Optimized Product Detail page rendering and overall frontend performance.

work.name: Frisidea
work.summary: Modernized web applications for insurance and customer care platforms using React and Vite.
highlights: Upgraded the TMLI web application using modern React and Vite.
Redesigned kitasiap.com for better mobile responsiveness and usability.
Built a web-based customer care portal for insurance policyholders.
Configured Nginx and managed Linux server deployments.

work.name: BRI Life
work.summary: Migrated the 'Mylife' mobile app to Flutter and built internal web applications with React and Express.js.
highlights: Led the migration of the 'Mylife' mobile app from React Native to Flutter.
Built and maintained the 'Digiform' web app in React alongside Express.js APIs.
Managed three concurrent applications, including Linux server setup and production releases.

projects.name: Resume Lab
projects.description: ATS-friendly resume builder built with Vue 3, TypeScript, Vite, and Tailwind CSS. Import JSON Resume files or fill out forms manually to export clean, parser-ready PDFs.
highlights: Built an ATS-friendly resume builder with Vue 3, TypeScript, Vite, and Tailwind CSS
Added JSON Resume import alongside manual form editing
Implemented clean PDF export optimized for Applicant Tracking Systems

projects.name: Mortgage Calculator (Simulasi KPR)
projects.description: Interactive mortgage calculator built with React and Vite to estimate monthly payments across fixed and floating interest rates.

projects.name: Sistem Skripsi
projects.description: Web-based thesis management portal built with PHP and MySQL to help students and advisors track submissions, schedules, and approvals online.
